changes.title: Clear to transform
items: Clear an area and its runestone turns into a soundsystem at once: invite every one of its wild animals, or see them run off (its sleeping legend and the baby in its circle don't count). Its babies dance, a party witch flies in and its music plays.
The waves keep their schedule along the ley line. A wave that reaches an area you've already cleared just celebrates: nothing is enraged.

Every area is full of animals from the start, and the areas later on the route hold more. Heavy kinds come as a few big adults, swarms as many young. Each area has two babies. Nothing grows while you play any more.
The boot-up takes 30 seconds, not five minutes, and a wave comes every 3 minutes, not 5.

changes.title: Sparkler pulse
items: The pulse on the ley line burns like a sparkler: a bright crackling tip spitting sparks, the line ahead an unlit fuse and the line behind burnt to ash, still showing the way home

changes.title: Legend outline circle
items: A sleeping legend shows its glowing outline only while you are inside its circle; outside, it is a mossy boulder in its clearing
